items.guidance: In vLLM the production server is typically the OpenAI-compatible API server started by the Dockerfile entrypoint; check its --port argument or argparse default in the server CLI code to confirm the value matches the expected 8000. If confirmed, add EXPOSE 8000 to the final serving stage of docker/Dockerfile, and add ENV PORT only if the server code actually reads a PORT environment variable.

Search the OpenAI-compatible API server module for an existing /health or /ping route before adding anything; if one exists, report its path and confirm whether an API-key check applies to it. Note that if the health route verifies engine liveness, it may return non-2xx until the model is loaded, so report that behaviour.

Check docker/ for CPU-specific Dockerfiles or build targets and check whether the build supports a CPU target device via a build argument or environment setting such as a target-device variable. Report the file, setting name, and value if found, otherwise report the CUDA base image evidence from docker/Dockerfile.
